entries:
If you return here tomorrow, I'm sure
the forest will say “Bienvenue" again!

I'm researching the Pokémon
that live in this forest. Hoo!{VAR BE01}
But there haven't been any Pokémon
recently, and the forest is forlorn.

If you see {VAR 0101 0000} in this forest,
please let me know.{VAR BE01}
That will be proof that Pokémon
are living in this forest.

Did you notice the sky's beauty today?
Tomorrow will be fine, too!
Let's go Berry picking together!

I need Berries for tomorrow's dinner,
so go pick some, OK?

Let's have a Triple Battle with the
Pokémon I have worked so hard to raise!

A Triple Battle is a new style of battle
in which you use three Pokémon!{VAR BE01}
Please get three Pokémon together
to use in battle!

Oh... I wanted to see
the Pokémon you've raised.
I'll work even harder raising my Pokémon!

Oh...
I hope I'll get to see them another time!
